what_it_does: Addresses multi-turn dialogue serving for large language models, where a user sends multiple queries in back-and-forth conversation. Current systems recompute the KV-cache (key-value pairs precomputed during attention operations) from all prior conversation turns on each new query, wasting computation. This work preserves the KV-cache across turns to eliminate redundant recomputation. It also implements length-aware scheduling that reorders or pauses long-prompt requests to prevent them blocking short queries, balancing GPU utilization and latency across multiple concurrent conversations.
